thread:
alexa: Hey team — quick ask from Acme's security questionnaire (SOC2/ISO). They asked for: logging redaction approach, who can access raw logs, subprocessors that see logs, and KMS key custody. Can someone confirm the short answers by EOD?

samir: Quick: logs are redacted at ingestion. We mask PII via regex and by schema. Example: `redact_patterns = [r'\b\d{12,19}\b', r'\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b']` — we also run structured parsers for emails/ssns. Ops only can request raw logs; requires JIRA + manager approval.

maria: Add: retention is 90 days in ELK, 365 for aggregated metrics. Subprocessors: Datadog (metrics only), S3 (object store), GCP logging (for hosted). For customer-facing note, call out that subprocessors do not have access to decrypted KV cache or customer payloads. cc @jordan to confirm.

jordan: Confirming: subprocessors have storage/access to encrypted logs only. KMS keys are customer-specific in Private, in Hosted we manage keys via Cloud KMS with envelope encryption. For SOC2 answer: we rotate root keys annually, monthly for data plane keys. Also mention HSM option for Dedicated/Private.

sec-bot: Automated check: no PII patterns in sample logs attached to thread. Found 0 matches after redaction run. Report ID: RDX-2026-114.

alexa: Perfect. For the questionnaire we should produce 3 bullets + a note about approval flow. Draft below — please thumbs up or edit:
- Logs ingested -> immediate PII redaction via regex + schema-based transforms; raw logs access gated.
- Access: minimal SRE/Support with JIRA approval + manager ok; audit logs recorded.
- Subprocessors: listing (S3, GCS, Datadog (metrics only)); no subprocessor has access to plaintext customer payloads.
KMS: hosted uses managed KMS with envelope encryption; private supports customer KMS/HSM; rotation policy included.

samir: :thumbsup: small edit — change 'Datadog' to 'Datadog (metrics only)'

maria: Also add link to internal playbook: https://confluence.redwood/company/security/log-redaction

jordan: I'll sign off on the final wording. @alexa, if we need a formal approval artifact for the customer, I can attach an internal approval ticket template.

alexa: Thanks all — I'll update the questionnaire and send back. Filing ticket 1839123730 for record. Closing here.
